title.narrative: Supporting the Sudanese Ministry of Health with many medical items (the second and third batches of the sea bridge).

description.narrative: Filling the major shortage with medicines, solutions, medical supplies, electric generators and water tanks in hospitals and health centers in the Republic of Sudan for 730,000 beneficiaries.

Providing assistance in the health sector with medicines, solutions, medical supplies, electric generators, and water tanks, which helps alleviate the deficit in hospitals and health centers in the Republic of Sudan.

Providing medical relief aid to support the Sudanese Ministry of Health. Providing a helping hand to those affected regarding the health aspect. Supporting the Ministry of Health with medicines, solutions, medical supplies, electric generators, and water tanks
